messages.subject: Campus Drive: Vantage Systems - Backend Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Vantage Systems is hiring Backend Engineers (CTC 13 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT, ECE | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/vantageBE by 11:59 PM, 1 October 2026.

Regards,
Career Office
